# CANDIDATE: VIX_CONTANGO_REVERSAL_LONG

## Hypothesis

When VIX is elevated (>22) but falling relative to the prior day, SPY tends to mean‑revert intraday toward the VWAP. A long entry triggered by VIX‑level‑and‑close conditions plus a bullish engulfing candle above VWAP captures this short‑term reversion edge.

## Mechanism

**Entry:** At the close of a 5‑min bar, if VIX[t] > 22 and VIX[t] < VIX[t‑1] (falling VIX), SPY closes above the session VWAP, and the bar is a bullish engulfing candle (close > open and close > prior close), go long at the close.  
**Exit:** Initial stop at the swing low of the prior two bars; profit target at 2× risk or a trailing 20% chandelier stop from the highest high since entry. Only trades taken in the 09:30‑11:30 window when VIX > 20 and declining; abort if VIX rises >0.5 points over any 5‑min span.

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=28 contracts requires $25K+ account; $1K paper account would realize ~14% of headline P&L due to 50% per‑trade risk cap.  
2. **Sample bias:** Based on a single Stage‑1 BS‑synthetic run over the full 16‑month history (≈345 days). No walk‑forward or out‑of‑sample split; high overfit risk.  
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (no OOS/WF test performed).  
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (BS‑synthetic only; real OPRA fills may differ ±20‑30%).  
5. **Failure modes:** Worst day would be a strong upward gap with rising VIX (stopped out at initial swing low); max drawdown observed in BS‑synthetic run was $4,701.52; blow‑up scenario: persistent VIX contraction with sideways SPY causing repeated false engulfing signals and whipsaw losses.  
6. **Concentration:** In the BS‑synthetic run, the top 5 days contributed >999% of net P&L (top5_pct=999.0) indicating extreme concentration; real‑fills concentration unknown pending OOS test.
